add.k: Head of security at Rand Enterprises
st: Shannon throws Danny out of Rand, ambushes him on Ward's orders and gives Ward up, then is beaten by Colleen at her dojo.

files.notes: Named in dialogue in Iron Fist S1 ep 1 ('Hello, Shannon'; Danny: 'Shannon? Are you sure?'). On screen in eps 1 and 3 only.

k: A Chinatown patron married to the Hatchets' leader
st: Sherry takes over the Hatchets when her husband falls ill, unites them with the Tigers against Davos, and agrees to an uneasy peace.

files.notes: Named in S2 ep 2 ('Sherry Yang on the board?'; 'that's Sherry Yang'); also called Mrs. Yang. The Triad is called 'the Hatchets' / 'Hatchet Gang' on screen (the wiki's 'Yangsi Gonshi' is never said), so the group is 'The Hatchets'. She sits on the Bayard Community Center board in ep 2.

add.k: A New York TV news reporter
st: Reporter Thembi grills Mariah Dillard live on air about her crime family, then covers Luke Cage's standoff and street fight.
Thembi reports on Danny Rand's apology for a chemical plant cancer scandal, then on the drug charges against him.
Thembi corners Dorothy Walker outside the hospital and gets her on air asking fans to pray for Trish.
Thembi reports the severed heads left at Mariah's Chisholm Complex, Bushmaster's escape, and Harlem's rising crime.
Thembi covers Sallinger's release, then interviews Jessica live as Jessica calls Sallinger a serial killer.

files.notes: 'Thembi' said by Mariah in LC S1 ep 6; 'Call Thembi Wallace' in ep 13; she says 'Thembi Wallace, WJBP News' in JJ S2 ep 12 (subtitles garble the call letters as WJBT/WBPJ; the wiki quotes WJBP). Station is the group. JJ S3 ep 7 precinct scene is per the wiki; the interview is ep 8.

add.k: An Air Force major at Edwards
st: Major Allen tracks an unknown bogey with Rhodey and orders the F-22s to shoot it down over Rhodey's protest.
Major Allen greets Rhodey at Edwards when Rhodey lands there wearing Tony's armor.

files.notes: Only 'Allen' is said ('Get me Major Allen', Iron Man); 'Julius' comes from tie-in books, so it is not used. Not named in Iron Man 2. The Iron Man 2 transcript available is badly garbled; the greeting ('Colonel.' / 'Major.') is per the wiki.

add.k: Pepper Potts's secretary at Stark Industries
st: Pepper's secretary tries to keep Tony out of Pepper's office while Pepper is on a call.
Bambi gets a badge lecture from Happy, then tells Pepper her four o'clock has arrived.

files.notes: 'Excuse me, Bambi' (Happy, Iron Man 3). Not named on screen in Iron Man 2, and 'Arbogast' is never said, so the name is staged. Iron Man 2 scene is per the wiki (transcript garbled). Her four o'clock is Killian, but she doesn't name him.

add.k: An Army veteran healed by Extremis
st: Healed by Extremis, veteran Chad Davis tells Killian's camera about his injury, then dies in a Rose Hill blast called a bombing.

files.notes: Named by Harley and Tony ('Chad Davis', 'Mrs Davis'). The 'defining moment' video line is attributed to him by the wiki. A test subject is not a member of A.I.M., so his group is the Army he served in ('won a bunch of medals in the army').

add.k: A heart doctor Tony meets in Bern
st: Dr. Wu meets Tony at a Bern party in 1999, and years later operates to remove the shrapnel from Tony's chest.

files.notes: Introduced by Yinsen ('our guest, Dr Wu'). No hospital or group is named: Independent. His phone call to J.A.R.V.I.S. is in the Chinese release only, so it is left out. That he is the surgeon is per the wiki.

st: Dean Choi expels Riri from MIT for selling her work to students who plagiarize it.

add.k: A pyrotechnician in the Hood's crew
st: Clown works the Hood's heists beside Riri, fights her after John's death, then confronts Parker over Stuart's murder and is fired.

files.notes: Named in ep 1 ('You're up, Clown'). Parker fires the whole crew in ep 5; no new group is named, so Independent from ep 5.

st: Heirlum's CEO Hunter Mason tries to buy Parker off, pulls a gun when an alarm sounds, and is strangled by him.

add.k: Parker Robbins's cousin and right hand
st: John recruits Riri into his cousin Parker's crew, then admits killing Stuart and suffocates at Heirlum after attacking her.

files.notes: Only 'John' is said ('my cousin, John'); 'King' does not appear in the dialogue, so n is John. Also seen in Parker's ep 4 memory of a mansion robbery.

st: Rampage botches a break-in for the Hood's crew, watches Riri beat his time in a test, and is murdered on Parker's orders.

files.notes: He insists on 'Rampage'; others call him Stuart, and Riri says 'Stuart Clarke?' in ep 1. On screen alive in ep 1 only; Parker announces Riri is replacing him in ep 2; his murder comes out in ep 3.

add.k: One of the Blood Siblings, the Hood's muscle
st: Roz fights for the Hood's crew with her brother Jeri, ambushes Riri after John's death, and is fired with the rest by Parker.

files.notes: 'The Blood Siblings, Roz and Jeri' (Parker, ep 2). 'Blood' is said only as part of 'Blood Siblings', so n is Roz.

st: TNNL's CEO Sheila Zarate is cornered by Parker in her own tunnel and signs his crew onto her company.

files.notes: Named in eps 1 and 2 ('Sheila Zarate at TNNL').

st: Slug hacks for the Hood's heists, captures Riri's suit when Parker wants her dead, then is fired after the crew turns on Parker.

files.notes: Named in ep 1 ('Slug's gonna text you'). Fired with the crew in ep 5.

add.k: Riri's AI, made in the image of her late best friend
st: Born by accident from Riri's brain map, the AI of her late friend Natalie guides her heists and saves her from John at Heirlum.
Hurt when Xavier wants her gone, N.A.T.A.L.I.E. flies off and is caught by Slug, makes up with Riri, and is lost powering the new suit.

files.notes: Riri says 'Natalie?' when the AI first appears (ep 1); the AI spells out 'Neuro Autonomous Technical Assistant and Laboratory Intelligence Entity' and Riri says 'N.A.T.A.L.I.E.' in ep 2. She is a separate character from the human Natalie Washington (who is dead while the AI exists and is restored by Mephisto only after the AI is lost in ep 5), as J.A.R.V.I.S. has a file apart from Edwin Jarvis. No group is named for her: she serves Riri, not the Hood's crew, so Independent. Deleted when Zelma's magic overloads the reactor (ep 5), filed Deceased as J.A.R.V.I.S. is.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Shannon throws Danny out of the Rand building, then ambushes him in Chinatown, and Danny beats him until he names Ward. Later Shannon's men break into the dojo hunting Danny after his escape.
stages.whoA: The man he is sent to throw out, then kill
stages.whoB: Rand's head of security, sent to kill him

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Shannon runs security for Ward at Rand Enterprises. Ward sends him after Danny, and Shannon gives Ward up when Danny beats him.
stages.whoA: His boss, who sends him after Danny
stages.whoB: His head of security

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Shannon and his men break into Colleen's dojo looking for Danny. Colleen fights them off and orders them out.
stages.whoA: The dojo owner who throws him out
stages.whoB: A Rand guard who breaks into her dojo

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Colleen asks Sherry to steer her husband away from war with the Tigers and guards her at the parley. When Davos comes for her, Colleen gets her out, and they end with a peace Colleen vows to watch.
stages.whoA: A volunteer at her center who pushes her toward peace
stages.whoB: The Hatchets' leader, an uneasy ally

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Danny wrecks Sherry's parley with the Tigers by mistake, then saves her from Davos. At the community center she trusts him and gets the civilians out.
stages.whoA: The Iron Fist, who ruins her parley and then saves her
stages.whoB: The Hatchets' leader he has to win back

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Davos kills Sherry's men and her husband, and she vows blood for blood. He hunts her at home and at the community center.
stages.whoA: The killer of her husband and her men
stages.whoB: A Triad leader he hunts

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Thembi interviews Mariah live in her home, then ambushes her with questions about the Stokes family. Mariah ends the interview, but later calls Thembi in to film Luke's street fight.
stages.whoA: A councilwoman she grills on air
stages.whoB: A reporter who ambushes her on live TV

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Thembi corners Dorothy outside the hospital about Trish and talks her into going on air. Dorothy asks fans to pray for her Patsy.
stages.whoA: Trish's mother, who gives her a story
stages.whoB: A reporter she uses to get her story out

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Dorothy pushes Thembi into a live interview with Jessica. When it goes wrong, Dorothy gets Alias Investigations a plug on air.
stages.whoA: The manager who books her interview with Jessica
stages.whoB: The reporter who interviews Jessica

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Thembi interviews Jessica live and keeps calling Sallinger an alleged killer. Jessica swears on air, names Sallinger, and walks out.
stages.whoA: A private eye she interviews live
stages.whoB: A reporter who grills her on live TV

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Major Allen calls Rhodey in to identify a bogey. Rhodey asks him to call off the jets, but Allen orders them to fire.
stages.whoA: The colonel he calls in on the bogey
stages.whoB: An Air Force major who orders the jets to fire

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Rhodey lands at Edwards in Tony's armor, and Major Allen is there to meet him.
stages.whoA: The colonel who flies in with Tony's armor
stages.whoB: A major who meets him at Edwards

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Pepper's secretary tries to stop Tony from barging in while Pepper is on a call.
stages.whoA: Her boss, the new CEO
stages.whoB: Her secretary

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Bambi tells Pepper that her four o'clock has arrived, and Pepper goes to meet him.
stages.whoA: Her boss
stages.whoB: Her secretary, Bambi

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Pepper's secretary tries to keep Tony out of the office, but he brushes past her.
stages.whoA: Her old boss, who barges past her
stages.whoB: Pepper's secretary

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Happy, now head of security, stops Bambi to tell her she should be wearing her badge.
stages.whoA: The head of security who nags her about badges
stages.whoB: Pepper's secretary, Bambi

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Killian puts Chad Davis through his Extremis program and films him talking about his injury. Davis later dies in a blast that is passed off as a bombing.
stages.whoA: The man who runs his Extremis program
stages.whoB: An Extremis test subject

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Tony brushes off Dr. Wu with a joke when they meet in Bern in 1999. Years later Wu operates on Tony and removes the shrapnel from his chest.
stages.whoA: A patient he first met at a party
stages.whoB: The heart doctor who removes his shrapnel

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Yinsen brings Dr. Wu to the party in Bern as his guest and introduces him to Tony.
stages.whoA: The colleague who introduces him to Tony
stages.whoB: His guest at the Bern party

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Dean Choi calls Riri in, says MIT was too lenient with her, and expels her for helping students plagiarize. Riri heads home to Chicago.
stages.whoA: A student she expels
stages.whoB: The MIT dean who expels her

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Parker brings Clown into his crew and leads her on his heists. When she asks if he killed Stuart, he turns on her and fires the whole crew.
stages.whoA: Her crew boss, until he fires her
stages.whoB: His crew's pyrotechnician

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Clown gets Riri into the TNNL job and works the heists beside her. Sent to kill her after John's death, Clown fights her, and Riri tells her who killed Stuart.
stages.whoA: A crewmate she is sent to kill
stages.whoB: A crewmate who warms to her

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Clown and Slug work the Hood's heists together. Both are fired when the crew turns on Parker over Stuart.
stages.whoA: The crew's hacker
stages.whoB: The crew's pyrotechnician

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Clown and Roz work the Hood's heists and ambush Riri together. Both are fired by Parker.
stages.whoA: A crewmate, one of the Blood Siblings
stages.whoB: The crew's pyrotechnician

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Rampage signals Clown in during the botched break-in. After his death, Clown spots the lie in his autopsy and confronts Parker.
stages.whoA: A crewmate whose murder she exposes
stages.whoB: A crewmate on the break-in

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Parker slips into Hunter Mason's office and turns down his check for a contract. When an alarm goes off, Mason pulls a gun, and Parker strangles him.
stages.whoA: The thief who kills him in his office
stages.whoB: The Heirlum CEO he kills

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: John is Parker's cousin and right hand, running support for his heists and recruiting Riri. On Parker's orders he kills Stuart, and he dies at Heirlum.
stages.whoA: His cousin and boss
stages.whoB: His cousin and right hand

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: John recruits Riri into Parker's crew and works the heists with her. At Heirlum he attacks her and admits killing Stuart, and she escapes while he is trapped.
stages.whoA: The inventor he recruits, then tries to kill
stages.whoB: The man who recruits her, then attacks her

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: John and Rampage run support from the van on the botched break-in. Parker wants Rampage gone, and John later admits he killed him.
stages.whoA: The crewmate he kills
stages.whoB: The crewmate who kills him

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Rampage reports the botched break-in to Parker, who decides to replace him with Riri. Parker then has him killed.
stages.whoA: His crew boss, who has him killed
stages.whoB: His crew's tech man

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Riri beats Rampage's time in Parker's test and recognizes him from a tech Discord. She takes his place in the crew, then learns he was murdered.
stages.whoA: The inventor who replaces him
stages.whoB: The tech man she replaces

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Parker recruits Roz and her brother Jeri as his muscle and sends them to kill Riri. When the crew questions him about Stuart, he fires them.
stages.whoA: Her crew boss, until he fires her
stages.whoB: One of the Blood Siblings, his muscle

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Roz works the heists alongside Riri. After John's death she and Jeri ambush Riri, who fights them off.
stages.whoA: A crewmate she is sent to kill
stages.whoB: One of the Blood Siblings in the crew

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Roz and Slug work the Hood's heists together. Both are fired when the crew turns on Parker.
stages.whoA: The crew's hacker
stages.whoB: One of the Blood Siblings

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Parker appears beside Sheila in her stalled tunnel car, smashes her device, and makes her sign his crew onto TNNL.
stages.whoA: The thief who takes over her tunnels
stages.whoB: The TNNL CEO he extorts

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Parker gives Slug a haven in Chicago in return for hacking his heists, and sends them after Riri. When the crew turns on him over Stuart, he fires them.
stages.whoA: Their crew boss, until he fires them
stages.whoB: His crew's hacker

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Slug and Riri shut down TNNL's system together and plan the Heirlum job. After John's death, Slug seizes Riri's suit on Parker's orders.
stages.whoA: The crewmate they hack with, then hunt
stages.whoB: The crew's hacker

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Slug captures N.A.T.A.L.I.E. and Riri's suit after the AI leaves Riri. N.A.T.A.L.I.E. breaks free.
stages.whoA: Riri's AI, which they capture
stages.whoB: A hacker who captures her and Riri's suit

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Slug helps break Zeke out of jail and talks him through his bionic implants for Parker.
stages.whoA: The inventor they help implant
stages.whoB: A hacker who helps implant him

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Riri accidentally creates N.A.T.A.L.I.E. while mapping her brain, and the AI guides her heists and saves her from John at Heirlum. They fall out after Xavier's visit and make up, but Riri loses her while powering the new suit.
stages.whoA: Her creator and best friend
stages.whoB: The AI she made in her late best friend's image

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: N.A.T.A.L.I.E. brings Xavier to Riri, but he is horrified and tells Riri to delete her, and she flies off hurt. He comes to accept how much she means to Riri and is there when she is lost.
stages.whoA: Natalie's brother, who wants her deleted
stages.whoB: Riri's AI copy of his late sister

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: N.A.T.A.L.I.E. appears on Ronnie's projector, and Ronnie welcomes her and tells her the only way into Riri's life is to force her way in. Ronnie is there when the AI is lost powering Riri's new suit.
stages.whoA: Riri's mother, who welcomes her
stages.whoB: Riri's AI, the image of Natalie

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: At Heirlum, John catches Riri out of her suit and attacks her. N.A.T.A.L.I.E. tears into the greenhouse in the suit and flies Riri out as the doors seal John inside.
stages.whoA: The crewman she leaves sealed in the greenhouse
stages.whoB: Riri's AI, who pulls Riri from his grip

dropped.why: Never named in Iron Man 3's dialogue (springfieldspringfield transcript: 'TAGGART' appears only as a subtitle speaker label on his cry for Savin). Tony sees his dog tags in the crime scene hologram but only says 'two military guys' and asks about military victims, and no source shows his name being legible. Credits only.

changes.was: whoA: The MIT dean who expels her / whoB: A student she expels
changes.now: whoA: A student she expels / whoB: The MIT dean who expels her
changes.why: whoA is how Riri appears on Choi's card and whoB how Choi appears on Riri's; the two were swapped.

changes.was: At the community center she trusts him to get the civilians out.
changes.now: At the community center she trusts him and gets the civilians out.
changes.why: At Bayard it is Sherry who evacuates the civilians ('We're going to evacuate the building') while Danny takes on Davos; she trusts him, she doesn't hand him the evacuation.

changes.was: b: Natalie Washington, whoB: A hacker who captures her
changes.now: b: N.A.T.A.L.I.E., whoB: A hacker who captures her and Riri's suit
changes.why: Slug captures the AI and the suit, not the human Natalie, who is dead until Mephisto's deal in the last chapter; the AI now has its own file.

changes.was: Dropped as already covered by the Natalie Washington file
changes.now: File natalie-ai (A, two Ironheart steps, Deceased) and ties to Riri Williams, Xavier Washington, Ronnie Williams and John; Slug's tie moved to her
changes.why: The Natalie Washington file covers the human Natalie (killed, then restored by Mephisto) and gives the AI only a clause; the AI is a distinct character with lines and a plot (guides the heists, saves Riri from John, is captured by Slug, deleted by the magic in ep 5) and is named on screen ('Natalie?' ep 1; 'N.A.T.A.L.I.E., close the helmet!' ep 2). The app files AIs separately (J.A.R.V.I.S., F.R.I.D.A.Y., Karen).
